title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: SEC. 1. This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

status.provenance: Approved by Governor September 30, 2024. Filed with Secretary of State September 30, 2024.

pfas_definition.provenance: (c) 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

date.provenance: (1) Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product

who.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

action.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

products.provenance: (b) 'Menstrual product' means a product used to collect menstruation and vaginal discharge, including, but not limited to, tampons, pads, sponges, menstruation underwear, disks, and menstrual cups, whether disposable or reusable.

intentionally_added.provenance: (1) Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product
